Read `README.md` and current rollout evidence first. Produce exactly one multi-wake target-policy candidate in `solver/`. Keep candidate-specific reasoning in `logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md`, and add or materially revise at least one evidence-backed reusable lesson in `guidance/control_experience.md` from the assigned parent, sampled solver results, and inherited logs. If no positive lesson survives the evidence, record a concrete negative result and what later workers should avoid or test. The candidate is incomplete until both files are updated. Work only inside this Phase 2 workspace.

Use the fish-control bookshelf through this structured transfer protocol:

1. Before the first architecture proposal from the common naive seed, consult `guidance/skills/fish-control-primitives/SKILL.md` and its references.
2. On later iterations, consult it again when the inherited guidance indicates three consecutive completed iterations with neither a new controller mechanism nor a semantic improvement such as a new success, a better termination class, or a meaningfully different useful trajectory.
3. Consultation is required at those moments; adopting a primitive is optional. Do not use the shelf to justify scalar-only gain tuning.
4. If a source informs the edit, record a concise block in `logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md`:

```text
bookshelf_consulted: true
source_domain:
source_mechanism:
transferable_invariant:
nontransferable_details:
policy_translation:
falsification:
```

Translate only the invariant into normalized body-frame observations and the two-joint state-feedback contract. Prefer one mechanism or one small compatible combination. Published gains, species-specific kinematics, exact vortex phases, and task-specific routes are not transferable answers.

I’m using the wake-visual inspection skill first, then the fish-control-primitives shelf as explicitly required. I’ll read the workspace contract and both skill files completely before proposing or editing the single candidate.

The workspace confirms this is the mandatory first shelf consultation and that no CFD may be run here. I’m now anchoring the visual review to inherited guidance, scores, observations, metrics, diagnostics, and both keyframe rows; I’ll write the diagnosis before touching the policy.

The sampled set contains no semantic failure: all four capture from verified direct uniform still water, with the strongest result at 15.939T and the weakest scalar result at 16.044T. I’ll treat the weakest policy as the informative regression case and compare it visually against the best, while keeping the lack of an actual failure explicit.

The shelf’s C-start/closed-loop CPG invariant supports one narrow change: release carrier authority only when measured yaw follows the actual velocity-course redirect, not merely the broader route turn. I’m recording that evidence-led hypothesis now; the policy will remain untouched until the note exists.

The policy now contains one mechanism-level change on top of the sampled winner: redirect-specific response gating, with the evaluated 6–4L restoration preserved. I’m distilling the completed sampled result into durable guidance next; this is where the visual-signal skill requires a reusable lesson rather than candidate prognosis.

Both required files are materially updated, so the candidate is now structurally complete. I’m invoking the workspace’s mandated check-runner next; it will validate the policy contract and guidance materiality without running CFD.

The mandated checks pass guidance materiality and the editable-boundary/schema audit. The only failed command is environmental—no `julia` executable is installed—so I’m exhausting local Julia/module alternatives and running the deterministic static contract checks before finalizing. No CFD will be started.

Produced exactly one candidate:

- [candidate_target_policy.jl](solver/cases/dogfish_3d_shape_policy/candidate_target_policy.jl) — velocity-course-specific response gating with the evidenced 6–4L carrier-coupling handoff.
- [wake_policy_notes.md](logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md) — visual diagnosis, hypothesis, bookshelf transfer block, and falsification criteria.
- [control_experience.md](guidance/control_experience.md) — new evidence-backed regime-handoff lesson.

Checks passed for guidance materiality, editable boundaries, parameter schema, entrypoints, non-empty policy, and forbidden calls. The Julia runtime contract could not run because Julia is unavailable; no CFD was run.
